name: KLIFS_list_kinases
description: List kinases in the Kinase-Ligand Interaction Fingerprints and Structures (KLIFS) database. KLIFS contains 1,100+ kinases from 7,000+ crystal structures with curated binding pocket information. Returns kinase IDs, names, HGNC symbols, kinase family/group classification, species, and UniProt IDs. Filter by kinase group (TK, TKL, STE, CK1, AGC, CAMK, CMGC) or species (Human, Mouse, Rat).

name: KLIFS_get_kinase
description: Get detailed information about a specific kinase from KLIFS by its kinase ID. Returns kinase name, HGNC symbol, family/group classification, species, UniProt ID, IUPHAR receptor ID, and the 80-residue KLIFS kinase pocket sequence (standardized binding site residues used for structure comparison). Use KLIFS_list_kinases to find kinase IDs.

kinase_ID.description: KLIFS kinase ID (e.g., 1 for AKT1, 443 for AATK). Obtain from KLIFS_list_kinases.

group.description: Kinase group: AGC, CAMK, CK1, CMGC, STE, TK, TKL

name: KLIFS_get_structures
description: Get crystal structures for a specific kinase from KLIFS. Returns all annotated crystal structures with PDB IDs, ligands, DFG-in/out conformation, alpha-C helix orientation, binding site quality scores, and binding pocket fingerprints. Essential for drug discovery - identifies active vs. inactive conformations, Type I/II/III inhibitor binding sites, and DFG-in/out states. Use KLIFS_list_kinases to find kinase IDs.

kinase_ID.description: KLIFS kinase ID (e.g., 1 for AKT1). Obtain from KLIFS_list_kinases.

resolution.description: Crystal resolution in Angstroms. KLIFS sends a number.

quality_score.description: KLIFS quality score (higher is better). A number, integral for most structures and fractional for some (7.6).

ligand.description: Bound ligand PDB 3-letter code ('0GS' = no ligand, 0 = no ligand)

pocket.description: 80-residue KLIFS pocket sequence for this structure

Grich_angle.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop - angle in degrees, e.g. 59.5972.

Grich_distance.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop (P-loop) - distance, in angstroms, e.g. 18.0522. The three Grich_* values together say whether the loop is collapsed over the ATP site or lifted away, which changes what fits underneath it.

Grich_rotation.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop - rotation in degrees, e.g. 57.1354.

allosteric_ligand.description: 3-letter PDB code of a ligand bound OUTSIDE the main pocket. Returned as the INTEGER 0, not as null or an empty string, when there is no allosteric ligand -- measured 0 on all 85 rows -- so test it for 0 rather than for falsiness alone.

back.description: The ligand binds to the back pocket. One of the KLIFS subpockets (van Linden et al. 2014). Which of front/gate/back, fp_I, fp_II and the bp_* flags are true is what separates a type-I binder (front pocket and gate only) from one that reaches the back pocket, and it is only interpretable alongside the DFG and aC_helix conformations in the same row.

name: KLIFS_get_structures_by_pdb
description: Get KLIFS kinase structure data for one or more PDB entries by their PDB codes. Returns all kinase chains annotated in the specified PDB structures with DFG/alpha-C helix conformations, ligands, and pocket sequences. Useful when you have a PDB ID and want kinase-specific structural annotation.

pdb_codes.description: Comma-separated list of PDB codes to look up (e.g., '4ekk,3mvh,1iep'). Each must be a valid 4-character PDB ID.

oneOf.description: KLIFS annotated structures for the specified PDB codes

ligand.description: Bound ligand PDB 3-letter code ('0GS' = no ligand, 0 = no ligand).

resolution.description: Crystal resolution in Angstroms. KLIFS sends a number.

quality_score.description: KLIFS quality score (higher is better). A number, integral for most structures and fractional for some (7.6).

Grich_angle.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop - angle in degrees, e.g. 59.5972.

Grich_distance.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop (P-loop) - distance, in angstroms, e.g. 18.0522. The three Grich_* values together say whether the loop is collapsed over the ATP site or lifted away, which changes what fits underneath it.

Grich_rotation.description: Conformation of the G-rich loop - rotation in degrees, e.g. 57.1354.

allosteric_ligand.description: 3-letter PDB code of a ligand bound OUTSIDE the main pocket. Returned as the INTEGER 0, not as null or an empty string, when there is no allosteric ligand -- measured 0 on all 85 rows -- so test it for 0 rather than for falsiness alone.

alt.description: The alternate model of the structure, e.g. 'A'; empty when the entry has only one. Measured on 2 of the 4 chains of the example PDB entry, so a pdb+chain pair is not unique on its own: pdb+chain+alt is.

name: KLIFS_get_ligands
description: Get all ligands (co-crystallized inhibitors) bound to a specific kinase across all its crystal structures in KLIFS. Returns ligand PDB 3-letter codes, names, SMILES structures, and InChIKeys. Useful for identifying known inhibitors and their chemical scaffolds for a given kinase target. Use KLIFS_list_kinases to find kinase IDs.

kinase_ID.description: KLIFS kinase ID (e.g., 1 for AKT1). Obtain from KLIFS_list_kinases.
